source.name: BasketFaul - Fenerbahce'de Beko'nun yerine Tarfin (deal value: 7.5m euros per year plus up to 2.5m in success bonuses)
source.quote: Anlaşmaya göre tarfin, Fenerbahçe'ye bonuslar dışında 7.5 milyon euro verecek.

note: Two-season name and chest sponsorship (2026/27 and 2027/28) replacing Beko. BasketFaul reports 7.5m euros per year excluding bonuses, with up to 2.5m euros more tied to success in the BSL, the Turkish Cup and the EuroLeague.
